response.text: {"title":"Our understanding of the College's needs","text":"The College requires the service to be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment [REQ-0014], and proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC [REQ-0002]. The service integrates with the College's student records system through its existing REST API [REQ-0009], maintains 99.5% availability monthly excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance [REQ-0011], and supports signing on current desktop and mobile browsers [REQ-0004]. These measures ensure dependable operations, complete audit records of every signature event including the signer's identity, the time and the document version [REQ-0003], and secure document storage for ten years [REQ-0007].","cited_ids":["REQ-0014","REQ-0002","REQ-0009","REQ-0011","REQ-0004","REQ-0003","REQ-0007"]}
